principle: Mechanism efficacy and dependency necessity are adjudicated separately.

nodes.evidence: Not directly tested by Blocks I-V; remains a modelling requirement.

nodes.relation: Fundamental physical dynamics -> stable matter/effective physical structure
Stable matter + sustained driving -> persistent dissipative organisation
nodes.evidence: Block I B1 supplies an artificial demonstration of sustained driven organisation, not a universal generator of life or complexity.

nodes.relation: Persistent dissipative organisation -> causally integrated self-maintenance
nodes.evidence: Block I distinguishes persistence from maintenance and demonstrates causal internal maintenance, but does not derive B2 self-maintenance from B1 dissipative organisation. Reciprocal-topology necessity was reduced.
Block III retained retention specificity and causal retained-state use; direct present-state information can bypass online retention.
Block II establishes heredity and selection once a reproducing population exists, but does not derive reproduction from Block I maintenance. H2.5 remains deferred.

nodes.relation: Heritable variation + differential fitness -> population-level adaptive change
nodes.evidence: Block II retained H2.1-H2.4 and H2.6 in the registered artificial ecology.
Block III retained feedback specificity and timing/integrity effects; predictable tasks allow open-loop bypass.
Block III retained learning specificity and persistence; explicit contextual information can bypass parameter learning.

nodes.relation: Adaptive regulation and learning -> broad intelligent agency
nodes.evidence: Block IV demonstrates one model-based route to structural generalisation under causal/compositional/problem-family novelty, but does not establish a universal intelligence boundary or world-model necessity.

nodes.relation: Broad intelligent agency -> reflective self-modelled intelligence
nodes.evidence: Block V supports causal self-related control, but H5.6 reduces endogenous self-model necessity and no direct dependency from Block IV agency to Block V self-monitoring was tested.

nodes.relation: Physical and biological organisation -> phenomenal consciousness
nodes.evidence: No Block I-V experiment measured phenomenal experience or validated a bridge from intelligence/self-modelling to consciousness.

cross_block_edges.claim: Persistent driven organisation is sufficient to generate self-maintenance
cross_block_edges.reason: B1 and B2 establish capacities separately; the transition between them was not constructed.
Block II begins with a reproducing ecology; derivation from Block I maintenance is absent.
No cross-block dependency test linked Block II selection to Block III feedback.
No cross-block dependency test linked Block II selection to Block III learning.

cross_block_edges.claim: Retention, feedback and learning jointly constitute intelligent agency
cross_block_edges.reason: Block III mechanisms are causally useful, but bypasses exist and Block IV requires stronger structural-novelty tests.

cross_block_edges.claim: Model content and counterfactual rollout can support structural generalisation
cross_block_edges.reason: Block IV targeted corruption, correction rescue and horizon tests support causal use in the registered architecture.

cross_block_edges.claim: Explicit world models are universally necessary for intelligence
cross_block_edges.reason: Registered alternatives failed on decisive tasks, but the tested architecture class is not universal.

cross_block_edges.claim: Broad intelligent agency necessarily yields reflective self-modelling
cross_block_edges.reason: Block V was intentionally separable from Block IV and no direct cross-block necessity test was run.

cross_block_edges.claim: Accurate self-related information can causally regulate behaviour
cross_block_edges.reason: Block V active/passive, impairment, misinformation and rescue tests support the causal role.

cross_block_edges.claim: Endogenous self-modelling is necessary for the registered control function
cross_block_edges.reason: H_EXTERNAL reproduced the downstream function with externally supplied calibrated self-relevant information.
No validated bridge; no consciousness measure was part of Blocks I-V.

overall_topology: Conditional branching network with bypasses and unresolved bridges; not a compulsory hierarchy.
